POWER-1: core: J1 is a through-hole USB4085 whose four VBUS pins join the In2 VBUS_IN plane solidly (no spokes); F.Cu copper patches with 8 x 0.3 mm vias beside R1's input pad, one patch with 10 vias joining R1's output to Q1's source on F.Cu and In2, 8 vias at Q1's drain into the PVDD plane. Each 0.3 mm via carries about 1.2 A at a 10 K rise, so 8 vias = ~9.6 A against 5 A (1.9x). TPA3221 PVDD pin groups have 3-4 vias each (3.6-4.8 A against ~2.5 A per group at full power; the governor holds ~1.1 A average).
POWER-2: R4/R5 470k, C8 2.2 uF/50 V: 0.47 A inrush, 9.8 W peak, ~60 ms ramp (sim tb_core_fw_on_28v_FIX), 2.5x under the AO4485 SOA.
POWER-3: Lite R6 220k + C19 4.7 uF/16 V gate-source (~2.5-3 uF at its <=6.6 V bias, vs 2.2 uF simulated): Vsg 0.77 V on a 30 V/ms step against Vth min 1.7 V (sim tb_lite_pd_step_fw_off_sr30_FIX).
POWER-4: Same parts: 0.41 A inrush on a 3 A contract, 5.8 W peak over ~28 ms, >3x under the SOA (sim tb_lite_fw_on_20v_FIX).
POWER-5: TCA9539 has no I/O pull-ups: PVDD_ENG sits at 0 V through R7 100k until firmware drives it.
POWER-6: Q2's source on CH224Q PG (R20 10k pull-up): PVDD needs PVDD_EN and a good contract, as on Lite.
POWER-7: C8 2.2 uF: Vsg 1.19 V on a 5->28 V step at 30 V/ms against Vth min 1.7 V (0.5 V margin).
POWER-8: Gross-fault cut-off only: trips 31-35 V, above EPR's 29.4 V maximum and under the TPA3221's 37 V abs max; the PD source's own OVP is the primary protection.
POWER-9: SMBJ20A/30A clamp above some abs-max at full rated surge; the residual risk is a USB-C surge event beyond PD spec. No cheaper TVS clamps lower at these standoffs (SMBJ28A gains <2 V).
POWER-10: Lite C9 100 pF -> 47 pF (FF zero 15.9 -> 33.9 kHz) and a third 22 uF (C25) on +5V: about 33 uF effective at 5 V, fo ~37 kHz under TI's 40 kHz rule.
POWER-11: core SY8303 input 10 uF/50 V 1206 (~3-4 uF at 28 V) plus the 470 uF bulk on VBUS through Q1's body and the In2 plane; output 2 x 22 uF. Margin is thin, not negative; bring-up measures +5V ripple at 2 A (bench). Contingency: none on the board (no room).
POWER-12: Lite J1 is now the HRO part; the B4A9 VBUS pin still reaches the pour through one via carrying ~1.4 A of the 3.25 A a 65 W charger gives (one 0.3 mm via ~1.2-1.5 A at 10-20 K rise); the other VBUS pin carries the rest through the F.Cu pour. Margin ~1x on that via; worst case a warm via, not an open.
POWER-13: No amp enable without a PD contract of 9 V or more (firmware-requirements L4/C4); on a 5 V port the board runs the ESP32 only.
AUDIO-1: R73/R75/R81/R83 1.3k: + input peaks 2.75 V vs 3.10 V limit (0.35 V), output +-1.41 V with 0.34 V to the rails; 0 dBFS = 63 W/4 ohm, 1 dB under clip.
AUDIO-2: U20 switches biased nodes: NO = LSW_x (2.55 V), NC = TAP_x (1.65 V bias from +3V3/GND 100k/100k), COM -> C101/C111 -> ADC; swing stays inside 0..5 V.
AUDIO-3: Q7 inverts the 3.3 V select to 5 V logic (10k to +5VA, 47k base, 100k base pull-down): default high = RCA input.
AUDIO-4: Lite R54 10k: SDZ >= 2.7 V at the 50 uA worst-case input current (VIH 2.0 V); C26 47 nF keeps the edge under 10 V/ms.
AUDIO-7: Lite R30/R33 15k: FLX4's 2.1 Vrms reads 0.62 Vrms, -4.2 dBFS.
AUDIO-8: Invert the sub/ADC path while DJ_DIRECT is on (C5).
AUDIO-9: Hold both amps in reset across a DJ_DIRECT change (C5).
AUDIO-10: Y1 49.152 MHz (C7431354): 1.7 % under the 50 MHz internal-DVDD limit.
AUDIO-11: 50k +-1 % sits on TI's 49.5-50.5k window at 25 C; at the edge the switching frequency moves ~1 %, which the zone A/B sync and filter don't care about.

DIGITAL-2: Same: every expander output defaults to an input held off by R40-R45.
DIGITAL-3: Second I2S TX (I2S1 slave on the shared pads) for the sub DAC (C8). Hardware unchanged: no free GPIO to merge data lines without losing a strap-safe pin.
DIGITAL-5: C47 1 uF: nRST 10 ms after OE (oscillator starts in 3 ms).
DIGITAL-16: R57 holds LCD_CS low (display is the only SPI device; cs = -1); P17 is now the tap select.
DIGITAL-18: Lite: the keep-out under the antenna is copper-free on both layers (pass); the side clearance is 2.5 mm against Espressif's 15 mm recommendation. Contingency: the WROVER-IE (external antenna) is footprint-compatible; bring-up reads RSSI inside the box.
DIGITAL-19: core ANT_KEEPOUT on all four layers (x 148.9-154.64, y 189.6-213.5): no tracks, vias or fills; I2S_DIN and RMII_TXD1 rerouted west of it.
DIGITAL-20: RMII 82-126 mm unterminated: the reviewer's clock simulation passes with 0.52 V margin at the receiver; bring-up runs iperf at 100 Mb/s.
THERMAL-1: A heatsink pressed onto each TPA3221 from the lid with a 0.2 mm >=3 W/mK pad (19 x 12 mm base, <=20 C/W): Tj 101-108 C at 1/8 power into 4 ohm, 7-14 K under the warning point; nothing under the base taller than 1.25 mm. Board has no clip holes (no room without moving the PVDD decouplers). Firmware governor (C2) and OTW/FAULT handling backstop it; bring-up checks for no OTW at 1/8 power (C3).
THERMAL-2: Governor: 30 W per chip 60 s average from ISENSE (C2).
THERMAL-3: Lite RMS governor 13 W/ch at 4 ohm and FAULTZ recovery (L1/L2); at 1/8 power Tj 94-106 C (127 C even at hwde's pessimistic 47 C/W), 23-56 K under the 150 C trip.
THERMAL-4: Lite U8 EP: 16 vias (TI EVM ~32). The 1/8-power margin above already uses this copper.
THERMAL-5: core bulk ripple 76 % of rating at 1/8 power; 174 % only at continuous full power, which the governor (C2) prevents (30 W per chip ~ 1/2.5 of full).
THERMAL-6: Lite box wall gap / vents: for the enclosure task (THERMAL-6 says widen the side gap to >=3 mm or add wall slots; PETG, not PLA).
THERMAL-7: core Q1 drain now has an F.Cu PVDD patch with 8 vias into the plane.
THERMAL-8: CH340B in the Lite box: 52 C air at 1/8 power against a 70 C rating (18 K); 62 C at the governed limit in a 30 C room (8 K). The CH340 only runs the serial console.
THERMAL-9: core constraints.json: U15/U16 theta set from the datasheet with the heatsink (see the constraints note), not 8 C/W.
DFM-1: core J4/J5 use Lite's footprint: 2.0 x 3.0 leg holes and slotted signal pins.
DFM-2: Both boards: pins 1/3 are 1.6 x 2.4 mm plated slots centred between the two readings of the drawing (0.28 mm to spare at the pin corners), legs 2.0 x 3.0 as drawn.
DFM-4: core U18 is a front-facing IRM-3638T at the front edge (pin row 3.05 mm from the edge, as on Lite).
DFM-6: core J1 USB4085 pads 0.70 mm on 0.40 drills (0.15 mm annulus, JLC's multilayer minimum); front shell legs 1.74 mm inside the edge per GCT's drawing. Order remark: hand/selective solder, inspect A4-A5/B4-B5 for bridges.
DFM-7: HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 rated 20 V / 5 A; Lite asks for 20 V (PD tolerance up to 21 V, 5 %, normal for this connector class) at <=3.25 A (35 % current margin).
DFM-8: Order ENIG for both boards (0.4-0.5 mm pitch QFN/DFN and the 0.5 mm FFC); a few dollars per 5-board order.
DFM-9: EP paste 100 % with open vias: JLC's stencil default reduces large EP apertures; risk is voids/wicking, which ENIG and JLC's process tolerate on these packages. Option at order: filled/capped via-in-pad.
DFM-11: Merged PTH/NPTH drill file is accepted by JLC (plating per hole size); 0.20/0.45 vias cost a little more at JLC.
DFM-12: core U19 footprint has the T8BK's two 1.70 mm post holes at +-2.80 mm, 2.61 mm beyond the NC row; pin nets unchanged (physically the same pins on T8BK and T10BK).
DFM-13: KF301 1.4 mm holes for 1.0 mm pins: 0.2 mm radial clearance, normal for hand/wave soldering.
